rights_basis: The Pustet Ratisbon 1862 historical printing is public domain in the United States by publication date. This bounded image-checked transcription adds no prayer words and is excluded from the project CC BY 4.0 grant.
text: Deus, qui dedisti legem Moysi in summitate montis Sinai, et in eodem loco, per sanctos Angelos tuos, corpus beatae Catharinae Virginis et Martyris tuae mirabiliter collocasti: praesta, quaesumus; ut ejus meritis, et intercessione, ad montem qui Christus est, pervenire valeamus. Qui tecum vivit.
